description: Get hate crime data from the FBI at national, state, or agency level. Returns incidents broken down by bias category (race, religion, sexual orientation, etc.), offense type, victim type, offender demographics, and location type. Optionally filter by bias code (e.g., '12'=Anti-Black, '14'=Anti-Jewish, '22'=Anti-Islamic, '41'=Anti-Gay).

bias.description: Bias code filter: '11' (Anti-White), '12' (Anti-Black or African American), '13' (Anti-American Indian or Alaska Native), '14' (Anti-Asian), '15' (Anti-Multiple Races, Group), '16' (Anti-Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander), ... (35 total)

ori.description: Agency ORI code for agency-level data

state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation for state-level data

name: fbi_hate_crime
